artworks.title: Ghost of Sergeant Pelly
artworks.medium: charcoal, gray wash, and graphite with brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Alexandra and Michael N. Altman

artworks.title: Earth
artworks.artist: Jost Amman, after Wenzel Jamnitzer I
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof without text]
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This drawing features an ornate symmetrical design with a central leaf surrounded by decorative elements. The ornamentation includes natural and classical motifs, such as scrollwork, fruits, flowers, and mythological figures. The central focus is a large heart-shaped leaf with visible veins. The upper portion includes vases with flowers and a goat head, while small figures holding flowers are on either side. Lower elements like scythes, a sickle, and baskets suggest harvest and nature's cycle. Fine lines and high contrast contribute to the precision of the composition.

artworks.title: The Grand Waterfalls at Terni
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin

artworks.title: Sunset from a Rocky Coastline
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with pen and brown ink over graphite on blue-gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image displays a seascape with a viewpoint slightly elevated above rocky terrain. The horizon line is low in the composition, allowing the sky to dominate the scene. A dark silhouette is visible on the horizon against the lighter sky. The artist used a subtle brushstroke technique, blending shades smoothly. The color palette includes earthy tones of browns and greens in the rocks, contrasting with soft blues and grays in the sky. Warm orange and pink hues touch the clouds, suggesting either dawn or dusk. The ocean between the rocks reflects the sky, completing the serene composition.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Child and Young Woman
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals captured from the upper bodies. A baby sits on the lap of a woman. The baby faces the camera with a neutral expression, light-colored hair, and a smooth complexion, dressed in a light-colored garment with decorative trim. The woman, positioned to the left, gazes at the baby. She has dark, curly hair, wearing a striped dress with a high neckline and long sleeves, supporting the baby with her hands. The background is plain and dark. The photograph is framed in an ornate border with an oval-shaped opening, surrounded by a textured, gold-toned mat showing signs of age.

artworks.title: South from Ames, North Elba
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a low horizon line in the middle. In an open grassy area, there is a stone formation with trees growing on it. Two children in old-fashioned clothing are on the right side, looking at each other. Trees in the distance mark the field's boundary against a muted sky. The sepia tones give the image a timeless quality, with soft contrasts enhancing its vintage feel. The tonal gradations from the sky to the field create a calm atmosphere.

artworks.title: Loïe Fuller
artworks.medium: etching printed in brown on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Given in Memory of Martin Atlas by his Friends
artworks.description: The image shows a person in motion, appearing to be dancing. The person has one leg slightly raised, arms outstretched, and holding the hem of their flowing dress. They have long, curly hair, a serene expression with closed eyes, and wear a voluminous dress with detailed pleats and puffy sleeves. The person's feet are in dark stockings and shoes. The background is a plain textured surface.

artworks.title: Caryatids of the Erectheum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a section of the Erechtheion, an ancient Greek temple on the Acropolis of Athens, featuring the Caryatids porch. The sculpture consists of six female figures, known as Caryatids, serving as structural columns. They are carved from stone, likely marble, evident from the weathered appearance seen in the monochromatic tones of the photograph. The figures are larger than life, towering over the men at their base. The Caryatids exhibit elegance with their flowing garments and poised stances against the backdrop of the ancient structure.

artworks.title: Temple of Jupiter Olympius
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a view of ancient Doric columns, part of a classical ruin. There are eight visible columns with intricate capitals and detailed carvings. The columns support a damaged block. In the background, there are distant hills. A group of men is dispersed near the columns on a barren, rocky ground. Some are standing while others are seated. Subdued bushes are also visible in the image, hinting at the arid environment surrounding the ruins.

artworks.title: The Erectheum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image displays ancient Greek ruins with tall, weathered columns. The view is straight on with a slightly elevated point of view. Near the horizon, there are remaining structures of a temple, including columns with Ionic capitals and fragmented stone walls. The sky above is clear and light-colored. Close to the viewer, rubble and rocky ground lead towards the architectural elements. A few figures are visible nearby. In the distance, faint outlines of hills or mountains can be seen. The color palette is monochromatic in tones of sepia, adding to the historical feel of the image.

artworks.title: Parian Temple of Minerva on the Acropolis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an ancient temple ruin. The image shows a stone structure with classical architectural elements such as Doric columns and a solid stone construction. The ruin appears to be in a state of partial disrepair with scattered debris around its base. The stonework has survived the passage of time, showing carved patterns that adorn the temple's entablature. The background features a flat, barren landscape, emphasizing the isolation and antiquity of the structure.

artworks.title: Erectheum Caryatids
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient architectural structure in a desolate setting. The structure includes partially standing walls and columns with Caryatid statues. The background contains a rounded hill and an empty horizon under a sky. Stones and columns are scattered around the ruins, and two figures in dark clothing are present. The scene is depicted in sepia tones, reminiscent of early photography.

artworks.title: The Propylae on the Acropolis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an upward view of an ancient architectural structure with large columns and ruins. The surface is uneven with scattered stones and debris. Several people, dressed in traditional clothing, are among the remnants of the structure. The color palette is sepia-toned, giving the image a vintage look with tones of brown and tan.

artworks.title: Temple of the Winds
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a historical ruin with distinct columns and arches on the left side. A group of people is resting on the ground near the ruins. In the background, there are rooftops and a tall clock tower. Other buildings and a palm tree are also visible. The color palette is sepia, highlighting the aged textures of the structures.

artworks.title: Temple of Jupiter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a vintage photograph of an ancient architectural setting with towering columns dominating the view. The perspective is straightforward and at ground level. The horizon is low and distant structures, including a hill with an ancient building complex, are visible. The columns exhibit intricate detailing at their Ionic capitals. The photograph is monochromatic in various shades of sepia. Several figures are seated on the ground, adding a sense of scale.

artworks.title: Temple of Minerva
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a group of ancient stone columns from a ground-level point of view. The columns dominate the composition, with a pale sky above and small buildings in the background. The image has a sepia tone, creating a warm, monochromatic palette. People are seated around the ruins, adding a human scale to the structures. The composition includes a central path leading towards the columns, showcasing the texture of the stone surfaces clearly.

artworks.title: Monument of Philopappos
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a detailed frieze with human figures in flowing garments on a stone structure made of large, stacked stone blocks. The material appears to be light-colored stone like limestone or marble. The sculpture is large, towering over three people at its base. The figures in the frieze are life-sized or larger, suggesting the sculpture's intended grandeur and significance. The people are dressed in 19th-century attire, providing a sense of scale next to the sculpture.

artworks.title: Areopagus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky hilltop with people engaged in conversation or resting. In the background, there are mountains and a town with various buildings. The color palette is primarily in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Temple of Minerva
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows ancient stone columns in a clear, orderly line. The horizon is low, emphasizing the columns against the sky. In the distance, low buildings and a mountain range are visible. The image likely depicts a photograph of the stone columns, showing their texture and weathering. The color palette is monochromatic, giving an aged look. A person stands close to a column, providing scale, with others sitting on the grass nearby.

artworks.title: The Theseum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient Greek temple from a slightly elevated point of view, displaying its length and column alignment. The horizon is low, separating the sky and the earth. The temple's structure dominates the scene, with columns casting shadows. The image is a photograph, not a painting, with a grayscale color palette emphasizing stone texture. In the background, faint hills and structures are visible. Rocks lead up to the temple, where a few people stand, providing scale to the building.

artworks.title: Tombs of Mamelukes
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a historical architecture view. Multiple minarets rise into the sky, with a grand mosque complex featuring a large dome and two slender minarets in the distance. Several ancient, ornately carved minarets are visible in the foreground, with detailed stonework. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. Stone buildings in the distance create a layered effect, leading towards the central mosque. The sky above is empty.

artworks.title: Golden Gate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a stone wall with a gate, debris on the ground, a couple of figures, and a sky in varying shades of gray and brown.

artworks.title: Jerusalem - Section of Old City
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a historic stone fortification with massive towers and walls built from rectangular stones. The view is from an elevated perspective looking down, showing the structure with a high horizon. A flag waves on the tallest tower on the right. The architecture consists of intact and partial walls, with at least one arched entrance visible. The color palette is monochromatic, varying shades of gray. The image may appear more like a historical photograph with fine details, rather than a painting. Other buildings extend into the distance beyond the stone structures.

artworks.title: Porte de Damas
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of a large stone gate complex with high walls. The horizon is at the top of the image. The walls appear sturdy with heavy texture and substantial stonework. The color palette is primarily sepia brown. The ground in front of the gate is rocky with patches of dirt and a path leading to the entrance where several figures are visible. In the distance, to the right of the gate, domed structures can be seen.
